I am 73 years old. I have farmed these fields in Quzhou for 50 years, since I was 23. I only finished primary school, but I know my land. I learned everything from my father and from watching the good farmers in our village. If my neighbor Li Laohan has a good harvest, I copy what he did.

My farm is 5 mu. I have 3.5 mu in wheat-maize rotation, and 1.5 mu I plant with cotton. There are only two of us in the house now, so I cannot manage too much land, and I do not hire much labor — it costs too much.

For wheat, I do what I did last year. In October, I rotary till the 3.5 mu and sow improved wheat seed, about 30 jin per mu. When I sow, I spread one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that is 100 jin per mu. Then in March, when the wheat turns green, I top-dress with half a bag of urea, about 45 jin per mu. Fertilizer is expensive now, but I would rather use a bit too much than lose yield. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just money. I irrigate three times: once after sowing if the autumn is dry, once at green-up, and once at heading. I spray insecticide twice and herbicide once, and if it looks like disease might come, I spray fungicide once too. I expect about 1000 jin per mu, same as last year if the frost does not kill it.

For maize, I plant right after the wheat harvest in June on the same 3.5 mu. I do not till again — I sow directly into the wheat stubble. I use hybrid maize seed, about 2 jin per mu. I put down 80 jin of compound fertilizer per mu at sowing. That is what everyone here does, so I do it too. I irrigate twice, and I spray for insects twice and weeds once. Maize is easier than cotton. I expect about 1100 jin per mu.

For cotton on my 1.5 mu, I rotary till in April and sow improved cotton seed, about 3 jin per mu. I put 100 jin of compound fertilizer per mu as base, and when it flowers I add another 20 jin of urea per mu. Cotton needs a lot of spraying — bollworm is terrible here. I spray insecticide 13 times, maybe 14 if the worms are bad, and I spray herbicide once. I irrigate two times. I hope for 550 jin per mu. Cotton uses up a lot of my pesticide budget, so I have to be careful with money on other things, but without those sprays the cotton is ruined.

I watch my neighbors. If they use one bag of compound per mu, I use one bag. If they irrigate three times, I irrigate three times. That is how I have farmed for 50 years, and I am still here.
